title: API Reactor Yield & Solvent Recovery: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
description: Report chemical batch synthesis yields, solvent recovery percentages, and finished batch releases.
learning_objectives: Distinguish Present Perfect (recent batch results) from Past Simple (stated times)
Report chemical reaction yields using correct aspectual verbs
Avoid Czech aspectual confusion in chemical production briefings

questions.prompt: We _____ three synthesis batches of active paracetamol this week.

explanations.correct: Unfinished time frame ('this week') requires Present Perfect: 'have synthesized'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Tento týden jsme syntetizovali'. Unfinished time takes Present Perfect: 'have synthesized'.

questions.prompt: Yesterday at 14:00, the process chemist _____ the temperature in reactor 2.

explanations.correct: Specific completed past time ('Yesterday at 14:00') takes Past Simple: 'adjusted'.
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect cannot pair with specific past time 'yesterday'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Včera ve 14:00 chemik upravil...'. Specific past time takes Past Simple: 'adjusted'.

questions.prompt: The solvent recovery plant _____ 94% of the recycled acetone so far this month.

explanations.correct: 'So far this month' denotes ongoing time up to the present, requiring Present Perfect: 'has recovered'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'recovered' implies a closed past time frame.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Zatím v tomto měsíci recyklovala...'. 'So far' requires Present Perfect: 'has recovered'.
questions.workplace_track: Hazardous Reagents, Solvent Recovery & Lab Safety

questions.prompt: _____ you already verified the purity profile of batch TAPI-2026-08?

explanations.correct: 'Already' with past participle 'verified' requires Present Perfect auxiliary 'Have you already verified'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'Did you already verified' is ungrammatical (would need base 'verify').

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Ověřil jste již čistotu...?'. With 'already' and past participle, use 'Have you already verified...'.

questions.prompt: The crystallizer temperature _____ suddenly during last night's night shift.

explanations.correct: Specific completed past period ('last night') requires Past Simple: 'dropped'.
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect cannot be used with 'last night'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Teplota včera v noci klesla'. 'Last night' takes Past Simple: 'dropped'.

questions.prompt: The analytical development lab _____ a new HPLC method for chiral separation last quarter.

explanations.correct: Finished past time marker ('last quarter') takes Past Simple: 'validated'.
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect cannot pair with 'last quarter'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Laboratoř validovala metodu minulé čtvrtletí'. Past marker 'last quarter' requires Past Simple: 'validated'.

questions.prompt: We _____ the final release documentation to the QP yet; the assay test is still running.

explanations.correct: Negative clause with 'yet' referring to expectation up to now requires Present Perfect: 'have not submitted'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'did not submit... yet' is colloquial American, but Present Perfect is strictly preferred in technical English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Zatím jsme nepředložili...'. 'Yet' takes Present Perfect: 'have not submitted'.
questions.workplace_track: Pharmacopeial Compliance, Impurity Profiling & Regulatory Submissions

questions.prompt: The synthesis reaction _____ for three hours before the cooling jacket was activated.

explanations.correct: Past event that occurred prior to another past action ('was activated') takes Past Perfect: 'had proceeded'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'has proceeded' cannot pair with completed past reference.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Reakce probíhala již tři hodiny předtím, než...'. Earlier past action takes Past Perfect: 'had proceeded'.

questions.prompt: The chemical synthesis team _____ just completed the trial synthesis of the active ingredient.

explanations.correct: Adverb 'just' indicating recent completion takes Present Perfect: 'has just completed'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Tým právě dokončil...'. 'Just' with past participle takes Present Perfect: 'has just completed'.

questions.prompt: In 2025, TAPI Opava _____ over 150 metric tons of pharmaceutical intermediates.

explanations.correct: Specific historical past year ('In 2025') requires Past Simple: 'produced'.
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect cannot be used with a specific past year like 'In 2025'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'V roce 2025 vyrobila...'. Historical years take Past Simple: 'produced'.
